_comment: Query-family rules for scripts/build_demand_families.js. A measured query joins the FIRST family whose pattern matches it (case-insensitive regex on the query). Order is deliberate: comparison wording (best/top/compare/vs + platforms/companies, in an event context) is tested before the head terms it contains, so 'best hybrid event platforms' joins the comparison family whose page Google actually shows for it.
A query no rule matches joins an automatic family named after the head slug of the page Google showed it on, so every measured query belongs to exactly one family.

primary_route is the page that serves the family. Where Google measured a top-level URL that now 301s to its /programmatic/ twin, the twin is the primary: it is the 200 page, and 1,500+ hash-locked pages already link to it, so redirecting it would put every one of those links through a hop.
